This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 9 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/ph/manila/RPLL.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: PAGASA forecasts for Metro Manila on August 9 point to a daily maximum of 29–31°C under the southwest monsoon, or habagat, which is driving widespread cloud cover, scattered to heavy rains, and elevated humidity that typically caps daytime heating. These conditions align with the market’s heaviest trading on 29°C and 28°C outcomes, as monsoon-enhanced convection often suppresses peaks below the 31°C August average. Official outlooks show 60–90% rain probability, consistent with historical patterns where prolonged cloudiness limits solar heating during peak wet-season months. Updated PAGASA briefings and any late-model adjustments to monsoon intensity remain the key near-term catalysts that could shift implied probabilities before resolution.
